d: Rashtriy janta dal (RJD) netri rohini aachary dvara mukhyamantri nitish kumar, tejasvi yadav aur lalu prasad yadav ke sath aane tatha BJP-JDU ke bich tanatni hone sanbandhi die gae bayan ke bad bihar ki rajniti garma gaee hai. is bayan par pratikriya dete hue bihar bhartiy janta parti (BJP) ke varishth pravakta kuntal krishn ne rajad aur lalu parivar par tikha palatvar kiya hai.
